name: lean-combinatorics-bench: Lean 4 Combinatorics, Spectral Graph Theory & Additive Number Theory Benchmark
description: An open-source, sovereign Lean 4 formal mathematics benchmark dataset comprising 95 machine-checked formalizations across Discrete & Convex Geometry, Extremal Graph Theory, Spectral Graph Theory, Additive Combinatorics, Algebraic & Enumerative Combinatorics, Arithmetic Dynamics & Number Theory, and Algebraic Topology & Monodromy, pinned to Mathlib v4.34.0-rc1.
